articles.title: ‘Major potential breaches of British election law’: Inside Channel 4’s investigation into Reform UK
articles.description: Gavin Lee is pleased to welcome Peter Geoghegan, an award-winning investigative journalist. He's the editor of the Substack Democracy for Sale and the author of the best-selling book "Democracy for Sale". Geoghegan explains the significance of the Channel 4 investigation not simply over the conduct allegedly captured on camera, but in the broader question of how political influence is financed and made visible, or invisible, within British democracy.

articles.title: France announces €1 billion aid for farmers after climate-hit summer
articles.description: France has recorded its hottest summer on record this year as the country battled heatwaves, drought and massive wildfires. The extreme weather has continued into September, with France's national weather service placing five departments on orange alert for several days. Temperatures are expected to reach 40°C in some areas. France's agriculture minister also announced a plan to unlock over 1 billion euros in aid to the agriculture sector, which has been severely affected by the extreme weather.

related.title: France announces €1 billion aid for farmers recovering from drought, heatwaves
related.description: France on Friday allocated more than €1 billion in aid to support farmers recovering from droughts after a brutal, record-breaking summer. The allocation includes €520 million for rapid payments to ‌help farmers deal with weather damage and a €235 million recovery ​fund to buy seeds, plants and ​animal feed, Agriculture Minister Annie Genevard said.
related.normalizedTitle: france announces 1 billion aid for farmers recovering from drought heatwaves

articles.title: Trump envoys Witkoff, Kushner to visit Russia and Ukraine in coming days
articles.description: US President Donald Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are expected to arrive in Kyiv for a first-time visit on Sunday, several sources reported. Witkoff and Kushner – Trump's son-in-law – have been involved in shuttle diplomacy between Russia and Ukraine, travelling to Moscow multiple times, and are expected to visit Kyiv this weekend. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more.

articles.title: Guerre en Ukraine : le siège des services de sécurité touché par une frappe russe en plein centre de Kiev
articles.description: Le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky a affirmé ce vendredi qu’un drone russe a «directement» visé le bureau du chef des services de sécurité à Kiev.

related.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : à la suite de l’attaque russe du siège du service de sécurité, Kiev dénonce une « escalade majeure qui appelle une réponse ferme »
related.description: Un drone russe a visé « directement le bureau du chef du SBU », Oleksandr Poklad, dans le centre de Kiev, selon Volodymyr Zelensky. Neuf personnes ont été blessées, selon le maire de la capitale ukrainienne.
related.normalizedTitle: en direct guerre en ukraine à la suite de l attaque russe du siège du service de sécurité kiev dénonce une escalade majeure qui appelle une réponse ferme

articles.title: Why early warning signs of glacier collapse in Nepal were difficult to detect
articles.description: The glacier collapse that led to devastating flash floods across the Himalayan region of Nepal and its border with the Chinese autonomous region of Tibet on August 26 was preceded by early warning signs, experts say. But monitoring and emergency alert systems in the region are still insufficient to predict such disasters.

articles.title: Israel's West Bank camp displacements could be crime against humanity, UN says
articles.description: The Israeli government's forced displacement of the entire populations of three West Bank refugee camps in January 2025 could amount to crimes against humanity, a UN report warned Friday. More than 33,000 Palestinians forced out of the Jenin, Nur Shams and Tulkarm camps have not been permitted to return home. Israel slammed the report for "spreading misinformation".

articles.title: Handicap : Emmanuel Macron annonce un train de mesures qui laissent les associations sur leur faim
articles.description: Si le président de la République a, lors de la Conférence nationale du handicap qui s’est tenue vendredi, défendu son bilan et réaffirmé l’objectif de l’accessibilité universelle, les acteurs du secteur déplorent l’absence de nouveaux moyens et l’insuffisance des contrôles et des sanctions.

articles.title: US midterms start with North Carolina distributing mail-voting ballots
articles.description: North Carolina on Friday became the first state authorised to begin sending out ballots, formally launching the 2026 US midterms as President Donald Trump’s administration fights to impose sweeping restrictions on the practice.

articles.title: Une « rupture de deux fils » de la tapisserie de Bayeux constatée après son transfert à Londres, mais aucune « dégradation majeure »
articles.description: La tapisserie de près de 70 mètres de long, qui a traversé La Manche au cours d’un trajet à hauts risques, doit être exposée au public à partir du 10 septembre dans le cadre d’un prêt historique décidé par Emmanuel Macron.

related.title: Tapisserie de Bayeux : les experts constatent une "rupture de deux fils" après le transfert à Londres, selon la ministre de la Culture Catherine Pégard

articles.title: "Je n'arrivais pas à me défaire de ma mentalité ukrainienne" : Daria, 18 ans, a fui la Crimée occupée par la Russie pour rejoindre Kiev
articles.description: Entrée à l'école en 2015, dans une Crimée déjà sous occupation russe, la jeune femme fait partie des premières générations à grandir avec les changements appliqués dans cette région annexée. Elle a appris l'ukrainien en secret et elle a quitté la péninsule, au printemps, pour s'installer en "Ukraine libre", raconte-t-elle au média public ukrainien Suspilne.

articles.title: Ce que l'on sait de la frappe contre un mariage en Iran grâce aux analyses d'images
articles.description: Ces analyses révèlent un faisceau d'indices compatibles avec l'hypothèse d'une frappe américaine. Accusés par Téhéran d'être responsables de cette attaque qui a fait quatre morts, mardi, les États-Unis ont annoncé qu'ils menaient "une enquête approfondie".

articles.title: Himalayan hydropower buildout: Expert says risk management is key
articles.description: Following devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, Access Asia takes a closer look at the fragile state of the Himalayan mountains. Dr Arun Bhakta Shrestha, an expert on the environment and risk management in the Himalayas, explains why it's so difficult to detect glacier movements in advance and says that the tragedy could serve as an opportunity to improve the way nations develop infrastructure in the resource-rich region.

articles.title: An inside look at Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles
articles.description: After years of delays and more than a billion dollars, the long-awaited Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is preparing to open its doors to the public in Los Angeles. The museum, founded by filmmaker George Lucas and his wife, businesswoman Mellody Hobson, will be a new home for visual storytelling spanning the Star Wars universe and beyond. FRANCE 24's correspondent Wassim Cornet reports.

articles.title: Nepal floods: Two workers pulled alive from tunnel after nine days
articles.description: Nepal's emergency crews have pulled two workers out of a hydropower tunnel where they had been trapped for nine days. The rescue comes more than a week after flash flooding along the Nepal-Tibet border killed more than 1,200 people. Both men have injuries to their hands and legs and have been airlifted to a hospital in Kathmandu for treatment.

articles.title: Israeli army has seized Lebanon's key Ali al-Taher ridge from Hezbollah
articles.description: Israel has seized the strategically placed Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon from Hezbollah fighters, Defence Minister Israel Katz said Friday. The Iran-aligned Shiite group did not confirm losing the highland, which sits around 10 kilometres from the border with Israel and was pummelled by Israeli strikes in recent weeks despite a ceasefire.

articles.title: La puissante étreinte de Jane Fonda et Gisèle Pelicot sur le tapis rouge de Venise
articles.description: L’actrice américaine et la Française ont été récompensées à Venise, ce mardi, par l’un des Diane Von Furstenberg Leadership Awards décernés chaque année à des femmes qui œuvrent à l’égalité et à la justice. La rencontre de deux personnalités hors normes, célébrées pour leurs combats.

articles.title: US state of Louisiana in battle over electoral map
articles.description: With just two months to go before the US midterm elections, the battle for votes is in full swing. Our reporter Fanny Allard has been to the state of Louisiana, where a redistricting row is playing out with far-reaching implications for racial equality.

articles.title: Mass burial reveals hidden toll of Algeria’s deadly ‘Black Wednesday’ wildfires
articles.description: Wildfires ripped across northeastern Algeria in late August. Photos and videos showing the mass burial of several dozen people have raised questions about the real death toll of the fires as Algerian authorities haven’t shared new numbers since August 26. A number of Moroccan social media accounts have also been sharing disinformation about the fires.

articles.title: Scandale du périscolaire à Paris : 17 familles déposent plainte contre Emmanuel Grégoire et Anne Hidalgo

articles.title: Stability or fiasco? Giorgia Meloni becomes longest-serving Italian PM
articles.description: PRESS REVIEW – Friday, September 4: Italy's Giorgia Meloni becomes the longest-serving prime minister in Italy's postwar history. While she's celebrated by the rightwing press, the leftwing press say her leadership is a fiasco. Also, is Europe gearing up for a chaotic winter? Concern is mounting after the UN warned of a "supersized" El Niño phenomenon that could bring heavy rains and snow. Plus we look at tributes to Gloria Steinem, journalist and women's rights icon, who has died at 92.

articles.title: Les chiffres de l’emploi aux Etats-Unis supérieurs aux prévisions ouvrent la voie à une hausse des taux
articles.description: L’économie des Etats-Unis a créé trois fois plus d’emplois qu’attendu en août selon les statistiques mensuelles du marché du travail et le taux de chômage est stable à 4,1 %. Ces chiffres pourraient justifier une hausse des taux d’intérêt alors que Donald Trump continue de réclamer leur baisse.

articles.title: UN ditches Mercator map to adopt more accurate one reflecting Africa's true size
articles.description: The UN General Assembly on Friday voted to shift away from the 16th-century Mercator map, designed by Flemish cartographer Gerardus Mercator, for a more accurate one reflecting the true size of continents. The resolution, spearheaded by several African countries and co-sponsored by France, was backed by 164 countries. The US voted against and six other states abstained.
